::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/imports/{id}/files/{entity}"}
#docs
One uploaded file as CSV, with an `import_errors` column added and, after the run, an `import_result` column. Correct the rows in this file and upload it again.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The import's id. |
| `entity` | `string` | **yes** | The file. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The file |
| `404` | No such import or file |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/imports/XXXXXXXXXXXX01/files/plans" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```text [200 OK]
Content-Type: text/csv

(CSV rows, one per record, with a header row)
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such import or file"
  }
}
```
:::
::
